# Chayce Properties — Full Content

> Chayce Properties is a full-service relocation partner across the UK, based in Northampton and founded in 2026. We manage every stage of a move — sorting, packing, removals, estate agent liaison, legal coordination, storage, and post-move settling-in support — through a single dedicated coordinator. Every client is assigned one coordinator for the full journey, and every move is fully insured. Services are designed with senior clients in mind but are open to anyone planning a fully-managed move.

## Company Facts

- Name: Chayce Properties
- Founded: 2026
- Website: https://chayceproperties.com
- Address: Unit F2B Barratt House, Kingsthorpe Road, Northampton, NN2 6EZ, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07708 925432
- Email: info@chayceproperties.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:30, Saturday by appointment
- Area served: United Kingdom (nationwide, based from one Northampton office — not a network of local branches)
- Typical response time: within one working day, usually sooner
- Every client has one dedicated coordinator throughout their move
- Every move is fully insured

## Packages

All packages are fully insured. Each higher tier includes everything in the tier below it. Full side-by-side comparison: https://chayceproperties.com/packages/

### Discovery Consultation — £150
A standalone introductory consultation, not one of the four move-package tiers.
- 1-hour telephone or in-person consultation
- Full assessment of your relocation needs
- Personalised move plan document
- Recommended timeline and budget breakdown
- Priority access to our full-service packages

### Bronze Essentials — from £995
Entry-level package for straightforward relocations, once your destination is confirmed.
- Professional packing of all rooms
- Fully insured removal to your new home
- Furniture reassembly at destination
- Light cleaning of vacated property
- Dedicated move coordinator

### Silver Comfort — from £1,850
Everything in Bronze Essentials, plus:
- Home sorting and declutter assistance
- Property staging for sale
- Utility transfer management
- Deep clean of vacated property
- Post-move unpacking and setup

### Gold Prestige — from £3,250
Everything in Silver Comfort, plus:
- Chauffeur-driven property viewings
- Estate agent liaison
- Solicitor coordination
- Full home staging with photography
- Storage solutions (up to 6 weeks)
- White-glove unpacking & styling

### Platinum Bespoke — from £6,500
Everything in Gold Prestige, plus:
- Fully bespoke & unlimited scope
- Personal lifestyle concierge
- New area orientation & introductions
- Interior designer consultation
- Ongoing post-move concierge support (3 months)
- Dedicated senior coordinator throughout

Each package page (and the Discovery Consultation page) includes a real, anonymized client story describing that tier's actual client journey — not a composite or invented example.

## Areas Covered

Chayce is a nationwide UK relocation service based in Northampton — it does not operate local branches, but has specific guidance for regions it serves most often:

- London & the South East (https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/london-south-east/): longer property chains, leasehold sale considerations, congestion/ULEZ and building-access logistics.
- The Home Counties (https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/home-counties/): village and rural access logistics, closest region to Chayce's Northampton base alongside the Cotswolds & Midlands.
- South West & the Coast (https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/south-west-coast/): higher density of retirement developments and age-restricted communities, coastal property survey considerations.
- Cotswolds & Rural Midlands (https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/cotswolds-midlands/): period and listed properties, closest region to Chayce's Northampton base.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you cover?**
We work with clients across the whole UK, including London & the South East, the Home Counties, the South West & coast, and the Cotswolds & rural Midlands.

**How early should I get in touch?**
As early as possible — ideally 3 to 6 months before your intended move date. However, we can accommodate shorter timescales where needed.

**How does the Discovery Consultation work?**
A detailed 1-hour consultation (in person or by telephone) to understand your needs and deliver a personalised move plan, timeline and budget.

**Can you help if I haven't sold my home yet?**
Yes. Silver Comfort and above include home sorting, declutter assistance and property staging to help prepare your current home for sale.

**What makes Chayce different from a regular removal company?**
A regular removal company gets your boxes from A to B. Chayce manages the whole transition — sorting, sale-side support, legal coordination and settling in — through a single relocation partner, rather than several separate providers you have to manage yourself.

**Can I just book individual services?**
Packages are designed to give the best value and experience, but bespoke requirements can be discussed directly.

**Are your services just for seniors?**
Services are designed with seniors in mind, but anyone who values a fully-managed relocation experience is welcome.

**Is my move fully insured?**
Yes, without exception. Every move is fully insured, and your coordinator can walk you through exactly what that covers before the day itself.

**What should I expect after I send an enquiry?**
A response within one working day, usually much sooner.

**Do I have to decide on a package before contacting Chayce Properties?**
No — the team helps determine what fits once they understand the situation.

**Is there any pressure to book when I reach out?**
No obligation or pressure — the conversation is relaxed and focused on determining fit.

**Will I have the same coordinator the whole way through?**
Yes. The same coordinator stays with a client from the first conversation through to settling in — there is no handoff to someone new partway through.

**What happens if a moving date changes partway through?**
The plan is built to flex. If dates shift, the coordinator adjusts bookings and timelines around the new date rather than restarting the plan.
